comments.value: Would love to drop a message to people. Especially if we meet, something happens that causes us to be separated but we forgot to add each other in vrchat and ofc we havent added each other elsewhere. I think i have lost two or three potential friends in a similar fashion already. And oof me for having a long Scandinavian looking name.
I can't believe this isn't a thing yet, we need it!

Can I just add a copypasta for why we really shouldn't get a text chat feature for this game?

There's been multiple other cannies about this idea.

I disagree on the text chat feature as it will discourage users from interacting socially with voice and encourage mutes. While there is nothing wrong with mutes its not exactly the best experience for a social platform. Text chat would also be very intrusive and annoying for vr users where it be a hand trigger for a text menu or displayed on the screen.

Messages in vrchat would be handy. With limits like 150characters as I would not like to receive spam and also make an option for friends only to send messages. I like this idea incase I am in a private world or editing worlds and people request on me when I am busy so they dont think I am ignoring them.

I agree 100%. Adding actual text chat in this game would turn it into mute desktopper chat. This game was absolutely instrumental in me getting over my anxiety and autism-related issues, if the game allowed text chat I would have dropped the game within 2 days.
Text chat, no. Short limited direct messages to friends, sure.
@{5adfa711a8ca626f7bf243ae|full_name}: Why would you be against text chat and be in favour of DMs? The former is just dms arranged differently with message history.
there is already a textbox in vrchat...
@{6015a8dedd548068697b6112|full_name} This canny was opened 5 years ago when text boxes didn't exist yet.

comments.mergedPostDetails: Very simple in-game but not in-world chat system inspired by Steam Direct Messaging. Would be useful for cross-platform temporary messaging to VRChat users when the only platform the users have in common is VRChat itself (ie they have not met anywhere else yet.)

details: Have an inbox in Vrchat. or add a text chat feature
title: DM capability's inside VRchat
